offering_description.value: Buys portfolios of charged-off consumer receivables, mainly credit card debt, from banks, lenders and other creditors at a discount. It then collects on them through its own call centers, digital outreach, legal channels and third-party agencies, and runs purchase pricing and collection analytics.

primary_services.value: purchasing charged-off consumer receivable portfolios; debt collection and recovery; consumer payment plans and settlements; portfolio analytics and pricing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit card issuers, consumer lenders and other creditors selling charged-off receivables; B2C: Consumers in default who repay the purchased debt through payment plans or settlements

end_markets.value: consumer credit; banking and financial services; credit card issuing; consumer lending

revenue_model.value: other: Collections and recoveries on purchased receivables, recognized as portfolio income at a discount to face value; service fees: Smaller fees from collection servicing for third parties

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Buys charged-off receivables from creditors and recovers payments from consumers; service provider: Runs collection operations and analytics for the receivables it owns

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Latin America including Brazil, Mexico, Colombia and Peru

specialization.value: niche specialist: Purchase and collection of charged-off consumer receivables, mostly credit cards, across several countries

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct portfolio purchases from banks and lenders, including forward-flow agreements and auctions; other: Collection through in-house call centers, digital channels, legal collection and third-party agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Debt collection and consumer credit rules such as the FDCPA, CFPB oversight, state licensing, and foreign collection and privacy laws

notes: Based on recall of the company's profile; country mix and revenue lines may have changed.
